_scope: THIS PROJECT's use of a bench: which bench, what stands on it and where. Separate from the bench file on purpose - see bench.json's _scope.

arm._comment: Arm base centre. x 51.5 = 24 on centre from the main table edge (x 27.5), measured along the return. y 20.25 puts it ON the return's front edge. ASSUMPTION: 'on the front edge' taken as the base CENTRE on the edge line; if the base plate sits flush with the edge instead, the centre is inboard by half the base and y should drop by that much. YAW IS STILL UNKNOWN and is the one value that gates everything: until it is set the twin keeps its infinite ground plane, because a wrong facing makes the collision gate call CLEAR over real tabletop. 0 = along +x (out along the return, away from the main table), positive counter-clockwise from above - so +90 faces the side wall and -90 faces the room.

cameras.name: bench
cameras.notes: Aligned with the arm - same position along the return (x 51.5) - on the printed 60-degree wall bracket. LENS CENTRE 29 above the table top, MEASURED. `standoff` (how far the lens sits out from the wall face on the bracket) is NOT measured; the render uses a 2 in placeholder, which shifts the sight line but not its angle. Registry entry for the live camera is cameras.json - this is only where it is in space.

render._comment: Shadows OFF by default (Kyle, 2026-07-26) until the lighting is right - hard shadows over a half-built room read as geometry errors that are not there. Flip to true to experiment.

_view_note: Saved free-camera pose from the last --view session (MuJoCo units, metres). Restored on the next --view and used by --render. Delete this key to go back to the derived angles.
